inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "A pixel art sprite sheet for a game: six people of three foreign tribes, drawn 6 times side by side, the same person every time, each one whole and separate with empty space around it, on a plain flat pale grey background. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "clean readable silhouettes, coherent pixel clusters, one design in every pose", "lighting": "Clear daylight from the upper left, flat pixel colour planes.", "color_palette": ["#3e302c", "#7a6250", "#96703e", "#f07828", "#e2d6ba", "#a89880", "#5a443a", "#c8c8cc"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "A plain flat pale grey background and nothing else: no sky, no clouds, no ground, no shadows.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [195, 17, 807, 148], "desc": "a storm sailor of the Thundercoast, a foreign tribe: a long oiled dark blue sea coat, a brass helmet with a thin lightning rod on top, one person standing, seen from the side facing left"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [195, 183, 807, 315], "desc": "a storm sailor of the Thundercoast, a foreign tribe: a long oiled dark blue sea coat, a brass helmet with a thin lightning rod on top, one person kneeling in prayer with the head bowed, seen from the side facing left"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [195, 350, 807, 482], "desc": "a marsh walker of the Echo Reed, a foreign tribe: a woven reed mask and a cloak of long green reeds, one person standing, seen from the side facing left"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [195, 517, 807, 648], "desc": "a marsh walker of the Echo Reed, a foreign tribe: a woven reed mask and a cloak of long green reeds, one person kneeling in prayer with the head bowed, seen from the side facing left"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [195, 683, 807, 815], "desc": "a blood priest of Stoneveil, a foreign tribe: a dark violet hooded robe with shards of glowing red crystal on the shoulders, one person standing, seen from the side facing left"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [195, 850, 807, 982], "desc": "a blood priest of Stoneveil, a foreign tribe: a dark violet hooded robe with shards of glowing red crystal on the shoulders, one person kneeling in prayer with the head bowed, seen from the side facing left"}]}}
